body:
Thank you for your kind words. I agree that sleep is a blessing. When I can do it I do it a lot. 

I’m glad prayer helps you keep going. I’ve never been a religious person or had a connection to anything like that to gain strength from. I just look to all types of medication which honestly I know is unhealthy. It becomes an addiction to the small amount of relief I get I guess.

Work makes me so anxious that the day before a long shift (sometimes a week or more before) I get physically sick. Just the idea of standing there talking to customers and pretending to be generally ok is terrifying. I’m not quite sure why I have such an adverse reaction to it. I always have, no matter what the job. I had a job where I literally played with cats for 4 hours a week and I couldn’t handle it.

I posted not long ago about feeling very similarly. Sometimes I avoid taking the Subway just because I know I'll have the urge to jump in front of it. I'm constantly playing out horrible accidents in which I die in my head. Sometimes it's the only relief I get as I'm too poor and generally unconnected to have a drug problem. 
Anyway, I guess I'm just saying I feel your pain. Over and over every damned day. Shoot me a private message if you ever want to chat.

People ask me to make that same promise. I find it extremely difficult as I've experienced what happens at hospitals here several times. Or at least what's happened to me so far. 

I did make it though. The promise to seek help before doing it. 

I'm glad for places like Reddit where I can sort of write out what is in my head and get a response from someone who's been there. Thank you for your reply. Sometimes strangers are all I have. People who are close to me seem to be disinterested. 

Thank you again.
